title: Article 176 Article 176  The creation and transfer of a real right becomes effective solely by the manifestations of intention of the parties.
statute_text:
Article 176 Article 176  The creation and transfer of a real right becomes effective solely by the manifestations of intention of the parties.
(Requirements of Perfection of Changes in Real Rights on Immovables)
